# Revise the architecture draft

Read `draft.md`, the latest reviewer artifacts, and `reviews/triage.md`. Return
a replacement `draft.md` that addresses the highest-impact required edits.

For each blocking finding, apply the correction or record a deliberate,
evidence-backed disagreement beside the affected decision. Do not silently
drop a finding, add speculative product scope, or turn the draft into a review
transcript. Prefer deleting displaced or duplicated prose when adding a
correction. The revised draft must remain at or below 5,000 words.

On later rounds, preserve resolved decisions and address regressions rather
than reopening the entire architecture. Carry genuinely unresolved owner
choices into `## Decisions needing owner input` with consequences.

End with `<!-- COMPLETE -->`.
